title: Backend Developer
description: Master backend systems architecture: Server runtimes (Node.js/Go/Python), Relational & NoSQL databases, API design, Caching, and Microservices.

nodes.title: Server Runtimes & OS Fundamentals
nodes.description: Event-driven I/O, process management, memory allocation, and environment configurations.

children.title: Node.js Event Loop & Non-Blocking I/O
children.description: Libuv event loop phases, call stack, microtask queue, thread pool delegation.

children.title: HTTP Server Architecture & Sockets
children.description: HTTP request routing, headers, body streams, TCP socket connections.

nodes.title: API Design & Protocol Architecture
nodes.description: RESTful standards, GraphQL, gRPC Protocol Buffers, WebSockets, and API Security.

children.title: RESTful API Best Practices
children.description: Resource Naming, HTTP Verbs, Status Codes, Idempotency, DTO Validation, OpenAPI.

children.title: Authentication & Authorization (JWT, OAuth2)
children.description: JSON Web Tokens, Refresh tokens, Session store, OAuth2 / OIDC authorization flows.

children.title: WebSockets & Real-Time Data
children.description: Full-duplex WebSocket connections, heartbeat pings, Socket.io fallback transports.

nodes.title: Databases, Caching & ORMs
nodes.description: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis caching, ORMs (Prisma, Mongoose, TypeORM), and database indexing.

children.title: Relational Databases & SQL Optimization
children.description: Complex joins, indexing strategies (B-Tree/Hash), EXPLAIN query tuning, transactions.

children.title: Redis Caching Strategies
children.description: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, LRU eviction policies, distributed locking with Redlock.

children.title: Message Queues & Event Streaming
children.description: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, pub/sub architecture, event-driven microservices.
